product.description: LED filament candle lamp, E14, frosted (opal) glass, 2200 K, CRI 90, dimmable, hung at the centre of a silk lantern; the lantern's frame and silk are the stage's own pieces
product.codeBasis: the maker's article number, as CP Lighting lists it
product.status: listed by CP Lighting, a UK reseller of the maker

light.beamName: a filament lamp: light all round the lamp; the silk of the lantern, drawn by the stage, passes it on

electrical.control: phase dimmable on the mains (the resellers list it as dimmable; the dimmer type is not named)

housing.dimensionBasis: 35 mm by 100 mm as CP Lighting lists it
housing.materials: frosted glass bulb over LED filaments, E14 cap
housing.mounting: E14 lampholder at the lantern's centre

photometricFile.note: A lamp has no luminaire photometry; its light leaves all round it and the lantern's silk is Matter's.

sources.title: CP Lighting, Segula LED Filament 2200K Candle 3.5W E14 240V Frosted Dimmable (article 50200: 200 lm, 2200 K, Ra 90, 35 x 100 mm, 20 000 h)

unverified: The maker's own data sheet for article 50200 was not read; the figures are CP Lighting's listing.
CP Lighting gives a beam of '45-59 very wide', a reseller's class for a lamp; a filament candle lights all round, as the record takes it.
The spectrum's ultraviolet content is not published.
